definitions.explanation: Rigorous training to master a skill or art.
Spiritual discipline practiced in Buddhism and other religions.

notes:
{修行|しゅぎょう} refers to rigorous, sustained training — either for mastering a professional skill or for spiritual discipline. It implies dedication and perseverance beyond casual practice.

TWO MAIN CONTEXTS:
1. Professional: Apprenticeship-style training to master a craft (⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修行|しゅぎょう} — culinary training)
2. Religious: Ascetic or meditative practice in Buddhism (⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修行|しゅぎょう} — Zen meditation practice)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {修行|しゅぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to undergo training/discipline
- {修行|しゅぎょう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧: in training, undergoing practice
- {修行|しゅぎょう}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: training period/apprenticeship years
- ⟦{武者|むしゃ}→武者：28922_musha⟧{修行|しゅぎょう}: warrior's training journey (also used figuratively)
- {修行|しゅぎょう}⟦{僧|そう}→僧：noentry⟧: ascetic monk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {修行|しゅぎょう}: rigorous training (professional or spiritual)
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: practice (everyday, routine)
- ⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: training (systematic, often physical or military)
- ⟦{修業|しゅうぎょう}→修業：noentry⟧: study/training to complete a course (different kanji, similar meaning)
